IT.NET.USER.ZS.name: Individuals using the Internet (% of population)
IT.NET.USER.ZS.note: Internet users are individuals who have used the Internet (from any location) in the last 3 months.

IT.NET.BBND.P2.name: Fixed broadband subscriptions (per 100 people)
IT.NET.BBND.P2.note: Fixed broadband subscriptions refers to fixed subscriptions to high-speed access to the public Internet (a TCP/IP connection), at downstream speeds equal to, or greater than, 256 kbit/s.

IT.CEL.SETS.P2.name: Mobile cellular subscriptions (per 100 people)
IT.CEL.SETS.P2.note: Mobile cellular telephone subscriptions are subscriptions to a public mobile telephone service that provide access to the PSTN using cellular technology.

IT.NET.SECR.P6.name: Secure Internet servers (per 1 million people)
IT.NET.SECR.P6.note: The number of distinct, publicly-trusted TLS/SSL certificates found in the Netcraft Secure Server Survey (by hosting country), per 1 million people.

SP.POP.TOTL.name: Population, total
SP.POP.TOTL.note: Total population is based on the de facto definition of population, which counts all residents regardless of legal status or citizenship.
